infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Drift needs your camera to count reps automatically using pose detection.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Drift uses motion data to detect exercise movement.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Drift uses your location to save the places you choose, so it can suggest a task when you arrive. Your location stays on your device.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Drift checks when you arrive at places you've saved so it can suggest a task. This needs Always access to work in the background. Your location stays on your device and is never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Drift can read your calendar to offer today's events as tasks. It never changes your calendar and nothing is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Drift can read your calendar to offer today's events as tasks. It never changes your calendar and nothing is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Drift can match your contacts to find friends already on Drift. Contact emails are hashed on your device and never uploaded in plain text.
